newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Thirty Sri Lankan soldiers killed in fierce battle.
newsitem.headline: Thirty Sri Lankan soldiers killed in fierce battle.

text.p: At least 30 Sri Lankan soldiers have been killed in an offensive against Tamil Tiger guerrillas in the northern rebel-held town of Kilinochchi, military officials said on Monday.
"The army is spreading out from their last-held positions, an official told Reuters. "We're meeting heavy resistance. About 50 soldiers have been wounded."
It was not immediately clear if the 30 dead included the 11 soldiers killed in on Sunday when the military launched its latest assault on the rebels.
It was the first major push for more than a month by the security forces which had dug in north of Kilinochchi.

Military officials said they believed the separatist Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels suffered heavy casualties in air and artillery strikes on their positions in Kilinochchi, 285 km (178 miles) north of Colombo.
Western aid officials said medical teams in the area had reported shelling and bombing in Kilinochchi but were unable to give details.
